description.value: The High Point Resort is a harbourfront property on Quadra Island situated just 200 metres from the Quathiaski Cove ferry terminal, offering views of the cove and passing vessels. It offers five room types — from a Standard Queen to a King Deluxe — all equipped with kitchenettes, making it practical for multi-night touring stays. The surrounding area provides access to wildlife tours, sea kayaking, hiking at Rebecca Spit, and First Nations cultural sites at the Nuyumbalees Cultural Centre.
